item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 09/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An intense winter monsoon will continue to bring cold weather to the coast of southern China today. The weather will be mainly fine and very dry over the region. It will be very cold over inland areas in the morning and at night. The monsoon will be replaced gradually by a fresh to strong easterly airstream early this week. Under the influence of a relatively humid easterly airstream, temperatures will rise over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. The weather will be misty with one or two rain patches.

Date/Month: 09/02 (Sunday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5. East force 5 later, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Cloudy periods at first. It will be very dry. Cold in the morning. Mainly fine during the day.
Temp range: 11 - 17 C
R.H. range: 30 - 70 per Cent
PSR: Low
